senses.gloss:
ढक्क ढक्क, अस्, m., N. of a city or district
(commonly ढाका or धक्क; the word is said also
to signify a large sacred building); (आ), f. a large or
double drum, a Ḍhāk; coveting; disappearance.

ढक्कन ढक्कन, अस्, m., N. of a man;
(also written टक्कन, ढक्कम, थक्कन.)

ढक्कारी ढक्कारी, f. an epithet of the god-
dess Tāriṇī or Tārā, a Tāntrika form of Durgā.
